load_failed_detail: The settings file may be in use by another app or not readable. Check the settings folder, then try again.
invalid_file: The configuration file {file} couldn’t be read.

issue.invalid_json: Your last valid settings are still in use; fix the file and it reloads automatically.
issue.reset_to_default: The file was backed up and the defaults were restored:
issue.newer_version: {file} was written by a newer version of Wisp. Settings this version doesn’t know have no effect, but they are kept when saving.

general.description: Startup, interface language and updates. Changes apply immediately.

launch_at_login_desc.macos: Wait in the menu bar after you sign in
launch_at_login_desc.windows: Wait in the system tray after you sign in
launch_at_login_desc.linux: Wait in the tray after you sign in

autostart_issue.translocated: Not set to open at login yet: Wisp is running from a temporary location. Move Wisp to the Applications folder, then open it from there.
autostart_issue.failed: Not set to open at login yet: the startup entry couldn’t be written. Turn the switch off and on to try again.

general.start_hidden_desc: Don’t open any window at startup (except on first run)
general.ui_language_desc: All windows and the tray menu switch right away

update_policy_desc.notify: Show new versions in the tray and in About; you decide when to install
update_policy_desc.auto_install: Download and install in the background; takes effect on next launch
update_policy_desc.off: Never check automatically; you can still check in About

general.developer_mode_desc: Show latency and frame-rate markers at the bottom of the panel
general.log_level_desc: Logs never contain your text or API keys
general.low_memory_desc: Free up some memory after the panel hides
general.unload_panel_desc: Free the panel after a long idle period; the next one opens slightly slower

hotkeys.description: Global shortcuts and extra triggers that summon Wisp from any app.
hotkeys.unavailable: Global shortcuts aren’t supported in this environment
hotkeys.test_timeout: Nothing received — another app may be using it. Try a different combination.
hotkeys.test_timeout_fallback: Nothing received — another app may be using it. Try the alternative instead.
hotkeys.styles_desc: Translate the selected text with that style
hotkeys.styles_empty: No style has a shortcut yet
hotkeys.ext_desc: Summon translation without a keyboard shortcut
hotkeys.ext_unavailable: Extra triggers aren’t supported in this environment
hotkeys.bobber_desc: A small round button appears next to selected text; click it to translate
hotkeys.double_tap_desc: Tap {key} twice quickly to translate the selection
hotkeys.double_tap_interval_desc: Maximum time between the two taps
hotkeys.mouse_desc: Trigger actions with the middle or side buttons
hotkeys.long_press_desc: Hold the button briefly to trigger, avoiding accidental clicks
hotkeys.copy_wait_desc: When the selection can’t be read directly, how long to wait for the clipboard after simulating copy
hotkeys.limit_option_chars: Once ⌥ + a letter is a shortcut, the special character it used to type (such as ∂, ß, √) can no longer be typed in any app.
hotkeys.limit_secure_input: Combinations that produce characters may not fire while Secure Input is active, for example in password fields (not independently verified).
hotkeys.limit_option_meta: If Terminal or iTerm2 uses Option as Meta, you lose M-d / M-a / M-v; consider the alternative shortcuts.
hotkeys.neighbor: {app} also uses {combo}, which conflicts with “{action}”. Change one of them.
hotkeys.advice_altgr: Your keyboard layout has AltGr: {ctrl_alt} combinations can interfere with typing. {alt_shift} combinations are recommended.
hotkeys.advice_multi_lang: You have several input languages: {alt_shift} switches between them, so {alt_shift} combinations aren’t recommended.
hotkeys.advice_qq: QQ is running: {combo} is its screenshot shortcut.

providers.description: Connect OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini or any compatible endpoint. API keys are kept only in your system credential store.
providers.added_with_defaults: Added “{name}” and set it as the default model
providers.empty_detail: Connect a model service to start translating and recognizing text
providers.orphan_keys_one: {n} key hasn’t been removed from the system credential store yet; it will be cleaned up next time.
providers.orphan_keys_other: {n} keys haven’t been removed from the system credential store yet; they will be cleaned up next time.
providers.keychain_available: API keys are kept in your system credential store
providers.keychain_session_only: No credential store (Secret Service) is available, so keys are kept only for this session and must be entered again after a restart.
providers.keychain_unavailable: The system credential store is unavailable, so API keys can’t be saved right now.
providers.pick_desc: Pick a template — every prefilled address and parameter can be changed
providers.name: Name

protocol_desc.openai_chat: The most widely supported protocol; works with most services and relays
protocol_desc.paddle_ocr: PaddleOCR text recognition, for OCR only

providers.url_empty: The final request URL appears once you enter an address
providers.url_forced: Ends with #: requested as written, no version segment added
providers.url_appended: A version segment was added; end the URL with # to request it as-is
providers.url_placeholder: Replace {name} in the address with your own value

url_warning.suffix_stripped: The endpoint path at the end was removed: the Base URL only needs to go up to the version (for example …/v1)
url_warning.query_kept: The query string in the address is appended to every request
url_warning.fragment_dropped: The # and everything after it in the middle of the address was ignored; to request a URL as-is, put # only at the end

providers.key_desc: Written only to the system credential store and never shown again
providers.key_desc_optional: Local services usually don’t need a key; you can leave it empty
providers.key_rejected: The service rejected this key. Check that it’s correct, active and allowed.
providers.key_required: This service needs an API key. Enter one, then test again.
providers.key_draft_hint: Saved to the system credential store when you add the service.
providers.test_desc: Fetches the model list and sends one tiny streaming request
providers.test_partial_hint: The model list couldn’t be fetched, but streaming works — you can add models manually.
providers.test_stale: Connection settings changed — these results are from before.

test_notice.keychain_unreadable: The system credential store couldn’t be read, so this test ran without the API key. If the system asks for permission, choose Allow and test again.

providers.headers_desc: Added to every request; don’t put your API key here
providers.thinking_off_desc: Translation doesn’t need the model to “think”; turning it off the service’s way lowers latency
providers.max_tokens_field_desc: Switches to the other one automatically if the service rejects it
providers.merge_system_desc: Fold the system prompt into the user message (some vision models need this)
providers.strip_think_desc: Remove thinking content from the model’s output
providers.dual_auth_desc: Send Authorization and x-api-key together (some relays need this)
providers.gemini_key_query_desc: Use ?key= instead of the x-goog-api-key header
providers.delete_desc: Also removes its key from the system credential store and clears default models that point to it
providers.deleted_elsewhere: “{name}” was deleted on another device or in the settings file, so your latest change wasn’t saved.
providers.discard_confirm: Discard this new service? Nothing you entered will be saved.

card.openai-responses: GPT models — dependable for text and images
card.gemini: Gemini models — every model reads images

providers.card_others_detail: DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, OpenRouter, local Ollama and more

paddle.url_desc: The AI Studio job API by default. You can also use a service deployed on AI Studio or a self-hosted PaddleX service (ending in /ocr or /layout-parsing)

kind.jobs: Job API: requests are queued and the result is fetched when done
kind.serving: Deployed service: returns the result directly
kind.unknown: Unrecognized address: it should end in /api/v2/ocr/jobs, /ocr or /layout-parsing
kind.insecure: Public addresses need https; http only works for services on this device or your local network

paddle.token_desc: Get one from the access token page on AI Studio. It’s only written to the system credential store and never shown again. Leave it empty if your self-hosted service doesn’t need one
paddle.token_rejected: The service rejected this access token. Check that it’s correct, not expired and has permission
paddle.token_required: The service requires an access token: enter it, then test
paddle.token_risk: Access tokens have broad permissions, so don’t share them. With sync on, the token reaches your other devices end-to-end encrypted
paddle.test_desc: Checks that the address and access token work
paddle.models_desc: PP-OCRv6 recognizes text only; PP-StructureV3 and PaddleOCR-VL also recognize tables and layout. You can add other models by hand
paddle.slow: Slower: a few seconds to tens of seconds per image, depending on load

models.title: Models
models.description: Enabled models appear in default model pickers and in the panel’s model menu
models.kept_referenced_one: Other models were disabled; {n} model used as a default or by a style stays enabled
models.kept_referenced_other: Other models were disabled; {n} models used as defaults or by styles stay enabled
models.empty_detail: Test the connection or fetch the model list, or add one manually below
models.vision_unconfirmed_long: Image support for this model is unconfirmed; if recognition fails, Wisp marks it as unsupported automatically
models.reasoning_tip: Reasoning model: requests turn thinking down the service’s way
models.caps_reset_done: Reset — the next request probes again

defaults.title: Default models
defaults.description: Styles can use their own model; otherwise these are used
defaults.ocr_desc: Only models that accept images are listed
defaults.invalid: The previous model was removed or disabled; please choose again
defaults.invalid_ocr: The previous model was removed, disabled or doesn’t accept images; please choose again

translate.description: Translation direction, styles, glossary and panel behavior.
translate.primary_desc: Text in other languages is translated into this one
translate.secondary_desc: Used when the text is already in {lang}
translate.default_style_desc: The style the panel opens with; switch any time with the style button at the top right of the panel
translate.close_leave_desc: Close after the pointer moves this far away from the panel
translate.anchor_desc: Where the panel appears for selection translation
translate.long_text_desc: Ask before translating text longer than this
translate.cache_desc: Repeating the same text within 10 minutes doesn’t send a new request; press {combo} to regenerate
translate.secondary_same: Same as the target language; choose another one

styles.title: Styles
styles.description: The order matches the style menu in the panel and the {range} shortcuts. Drag the handle to reorder.
styles.model_fallback: Its model is unavailable; the default model is used for now
styles.reorder_hint: Use the up and down arrow keys to move
styles.name: Name
styles.output_desc: Markdown renders bold, lists and code
styles.dictionary_desc: Show pronunciation, senses and examples for a selected word or phrase
styles.temperature_desc: Lower is steadier, higher is freer; only for models that accept it
styles.model_desc: The model this style (including its dictionary requests) uses
styles.model_missing: The bound model was removed; the default translation model is being used
styles.model_disabled: The bound model is disabled; the default translation model is being used
styles.hotkey_desc: Global shortcut: translate the selection with this style
styles.prompt_desc: Hard rules against prompt injection and for formatting, plus matched glossary terms, are always appended
styles.unknown_vars_one: {vars} isn’t a known variable and will be sent as-is
styles.unknown_vars_other: {vars} aren’t known variables and will be sent as-is
styles.tail_desc: A sentence appended after the source text; leave empty to use Natural’s
styles.preview_desc: Assembled once with your current languages and glossary
styles.preview_sample: Wisp stays out of your way and streams the translation right next to your cursor.
styles.reset_desc: Bring back the built-in prompt and parameters
styles.delete_desc: Remove it from the style list and the panel

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.description: Matched terms take precedence over style rules. Identical source and target means “keep as is”; notes are shown only here.
glossary.empty: No terms yet. For example, “Tauri → Tauri” keeps the word untranslated.

ocr.description: How text is recognized from screenshots, image handling, and what happens afterwards.

mode_desc.lines: Transcribe line by line, keeping the original line breaks
mode_desc.paragraphs: Join wrapped lines into paragraphs; good for articles

ocr.no_model_desc: Download an offline model, or enable a model that accepts images in Models & services
ocr.max_edge_desc: Larger images are scaled down before sending; smaller is faster and cheaper

detail_desc.high: High detail — small text is recognized more reliably (recommended)
detail_desc.low: Low detail — faster and cheaper, but small text may be missed
detail_desc.original: Original image — only for OpenAI’s official endpoint; other services use high

ocr.auto_copy_desc: Put the recognized text on the clipboard when done

layout_desc.keep: Keep line breaks and blank lines as recognized

ocr.layout_note: Not for structured mode or direct translation. Switch anytime in the result panel.
ocr.transcribe_desc: Transcribe first, then translate — one extra request
ocr.window_detect_desc: Highlight the window under the pointer; click to select it
ocr.fly_desc: The selection flies into the result panel
ocr.history_desc: Keep recent results so you can look back
ocr.history_clear_desc: Delete all saved results and thumbnails
ocr.history_clear_confirm_synced: Clear all recognition history? It will be cleared on your other devices too.
ocr.history_empty_on_desc: Screenshot results will show up here. They stay on this computer.
ocr.history_empty_on_desc_synced: Screenshot results will show up here, encrypted and synced to your other devices.
ocr.history_empty_off_desc: Turn it on to keep your last {n} results to look back at, copy, or translate again. Text and screenshots stay on this computer.
ocr.history_empty_off_desc_synced: Turn it on to keep your last {n} results to look back at, copy, or translate again. Text and screenshots are encrypted and synced to your other devices.
ocr.history_off_question_one: Recording stopped. Also clear the {n} saved item?
ocr.history_off_question_other: Recording stopped. Also clear the {n} saved items?
ocr.markdown_unsupported: The current OCR model only recognizes lines of text and doesn’t support structured mode
ocr.markdown_fallback: The current OCR model doesn’t support structured mode, so results come out as paragraphs

clipboard.description: Remember what you copy, then find and paste it any time.
clipboard.enabled_desc: When off, the clipboard isn’t read; existing history is kept
clipboard.paused_desc: Stop recording for now; you can also toggle this from the tray
clipboard.retention_desc: Extra items are cleaned up while idle; favorites are never removed
clipboard.secret_desc: Things that look like passwords, tokens or private keys aren’t recorded
clipboard.secret_flash: Flash the tray icon when skipping
clipboard.secret_flash_desc: A quick flash tells you the last copy wasn’t recorded
clipboard.smart_desc: Spot phone numbers, codes and more in clipboard items, and paste just that part with a click. Detection happens on this device.
clipboard.smart_contacts_desc: Email addresses, phone numbers, web addresses and IP addresses
clipboard.smart_codes_desc: Codes from text messages and emails
clipboard.smart_numbers_desc: Tracking and order numbers, amounts, dates and times
clipboard.smart_identity_desc: Shown with the middle digits hidden. These are sensitive, so they’re off by default.
clipboard.otp_auto_delete_desc: Copied codes are removed from clipboard history after 10 minutes, unless they’re in favorites
clipboard.excluded_desc: Copies from these apps aren’t recorded
clipboard.excluded_recent_empty: No apps to choose from yet
clipboard.paste_on_desc: Clicking an item pastes it into the original app
clipboard.hint_bar_desc: A row of key hints at the bottom of the panel
clipboard.quick_paste_desc: {paste} pastes item 1–9; {plain} pastes it as plain text
clipboard.keymaps_desc: Common terminals are built in; add or override other apps here
clipboard.clear_confirm: Clear clipboard history? Favorites are kept.
clipboard.clear_confirm_synced: Clear clipboard history? Favorites are kept. Items on your other devices will be cleared too.

appearance.description: Theme, accent color, text size and panel sizes; every window updates live.
appearance.preview_text: Wisp stays out of your way: the translation streams in right next to your cursor.
appearance.accent_desc: Used for buttons, selections and switches
appearance.material_desc: System: translucent frosted glass; Solid: an opaque background
appearance.font_size_desc: Size of translations and recognized text; interface text stays the same
appearance.panel_desc: The translation panel picks a width between these limits based on the text length
appearance.max_height_desc: Share of the screen’s work area; longer content scrolls inside the panel

sync.description: Keep your settings and history in step across your devices. Everything is encrypted on this device before it’s uploaded.

intro.label: WebDAV storage you own
intro.detail: Nutstore, Nextcloud, a NAS and more. No Wisp account, no relay server.

connect.title: Connect a server
connect.subtitle: Everything is encrypted on this device before it’s uploaded

preset_hint.nutstore: Nutstore web › Account info › Security › Third-party apps: add an app to get an app password
preset_hint.pan123: 123pan web › WebDAV: turn it on, then use the account and password shown there
preset_hint.nextcloud: Personal settings › Security › Devices & sessions: create an app password
preset_hint.synology: Install {package} from the package center and turn on HTTPS. A separate account for Wisp is safer — use its password here.
preset_hint.custom: If your service offers app passwords, create one just for Wisp

connect.url_https: Only local network addresses can use http. Use an https:// address instead.
connect.url_invalid: That address doesn’t look right. It should start with https:// and have no “?”, “#” or account name.
connect.password_keep: Leave empty to keep the saved password

password_saved.macos: Once connected, it’s kept only in Keychain
password_saved.windows: Once connected, it’s kept only in Credential Manager
password_saved.linux: Once connected, it’s kept only in the keyring

connect.test_desc: Checks sign-in and read/write access, and whether there’s already sync data on the server
connect.test_stale: Address, account or password changed — these results are from before.

advice.auth: Check the account and app password, then test again
advice.credentials_missing: Enter the app password above, then test again
advice.https_required: Only local network addresses can use http. Use an https:// address instead.
advice.keychain: Test again, and choose “Allow” if the system asks

data.restorable: This device was already syncing this data

connect.content_desc: You can change this any time after connecting

pass.create_desc: It encrypts your data on this device. Enter the same password on your other devices.
pass.join_desc: Your data will be merged with what’s on the server. Settings already there take priority; model services, glossary terms and history that only this device has are kept. If this device synced this data before, anything deleted or cleared on your other devices while it was away is removed here too.
pass.restore_desc: Enter your sync password to continue. Changes this device hasn’t uploaded yet will still sync.
pass.rules: At least 12 characters, different from your app password and account
pass.forget: If you forget it, the data on the server can’t be read. Keep it in a password manager.
pass.generated: Generated and filled in — save it in your password manager first
pass.reused: Can’t be the same as your app password, account or server address
pass.forgot_desc: Clear the data on the server and start over
pass.forgot_confirm: Clear the sync data on the server? Every other device stops syncing until it reconnects with the new sync password.
pass.unsupported: The data on the server was created by a newer Wisp. Update Wisp on this device first.
pass.keychain_hint: macOS may ask for access to Keychain — choose “Allow”

connect.discard_confirm: Discard this setup? Nothing you entered will be saved.

server.title: Server
server.update_desc: Changed your app password, or need to enter your sync password again? Do it here.

status.transient: Can’t reach the server right now — will retry automatically

network.advice: Check your network or proxy. Sync retries automatically.

auth.reason: The account or app password was rejected
auth.advice: Enter your app password again in “Update passwords…”

forbidden.advice: Make sure this account can read and write there. Some services need it turned on first.

not_found.advice: Check that the address is complete — for example, the /dav at the end

quota.reason: The server is out of space
quota.advice: Free up space on the server, or turn off “Clipboard images”

server.advice: Sync retries automatically. If it keeps happening, check the service’s status.

https_required.advice: Only local network addresses can use http. Disconnect, then reconnect with an https:// address.

vault_reset.reason: The sync data on the server was cleared
vault_reset.advice: Reconnect, then set a new sync password or enter the one set on your other device

format_too_new.reason: The data on the server is from a newer Wisp
format_too_new.advice: Update Wisp on this device, then sync again

credentials_missing.advice: Enter your app password and sync password again in “Update passwords…”

keychain.reason: Couldn’t read the system credential store
keychain.advice: Click “Sync now” to retry, and choose “Allow” if the system asks

corrupt.reason: Data from one device couldn’t be read
corrupt.advice: Other devices aren’t affected. Syncing again on that device usually fixes it.

internal.advice: Try again. If it keeps happening, export diagnostics from “About”.

auto.label: Sync automatically
auto.desc: Uploads your changes as you make them and picks up changes from your other devices while you use Wisp

content.title: What to sync
content.verification_codes_desc: When off, copied codes stay on this device
content.images_desc: Including recognition screenshots; up to 10 MB each
content.ocr_history_desc: Only while recognition history is on for this device
content.ocr_history_local_off: Recognition history is off on this device, so nothing is synced yet
content.removed: Off: what this device uploaded will be removed from the server. Copies already on other devices stay.
content.local_note: Shortcuts sync only between devices on the same system. Launch at login, clipboard recording, secret detection, the recognition history switch, logging and performance options stay on this device.

danger.disconnect_desc: Stop syncing on this device. Data on the server stays, so you can reconnect later.
danger.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect sync? Data on the server is kept.
danger.disconnect_confirm_pending: Disconnect sync? Some changes on this device haven’t been uploaded and won’t be.
danger.reset_desc: Deletes all sync data on the server. Every device stops syncing.
danger.reset_confirm: Clear the sync data on the server? Every device will stop syncing. This can’t be undone.

update.ready: {version} is installed and takes effect after a relaunch
update.ready_windows: {version} is downloaded and will install and restart when idle
update.disabled: This build doesn’t support automatic updates

about.diagnostics_desc: Export logs and redacted settings for bug reports; contains no API keys or text
about.wisp_license_desc: Open source under the MIT License
about.thanks: Thanks to every open-source project and its maintainers.

fitness.gpu_unknown: The graphics card isn’t checked yet; without a dedicated one it runs slowly
fitness.cpu_only: No usable GPU, so it runs slowly on the CPU
fitness.integrated_gpu: Integrated graphics only, so it runs as slowly as on the CPU
fitness.low_memory: This device is short on memory; the model may be slow or fail to load
fitness.memory_unknown: Could not read how much memory this device has

offline.description: Models run on this device, so the text you recognize and translate never leaves it. Nothing is saved until you choose to download.
offline.gpu_none: No usable graphics card, runs on the CPU
offline.gpu_pending: Graphics card is detected after the runtime is downloaded

summary.pp_ocrv6_tiny: Fastest, runs smoothly on the CPU; doesn’t recognize Japanese
summary.paddleocr_vl_1_6: Tables, formulas and complex layouts; a dedicated graphics card or Apple silicon is recommended
summary.index_translate_9b: Higher-quality translations; a dedicated graphics card or Apple silicon with 16 GB or more is recommended

offline.update: A newer version is available; download it again from the menu on the right
offline.broken: Model files are missing or damaged and need to be downloaded again

in_use.ocr: In use for screenshot OCR; click again to go back to the default OCR model
in_use.translate: In use for translation; click again to go back to the default translation model

offline.delete_confirm: Delete {model}? Its {size} of files will be removed from this device

dot.preparing: Getting ready. The first run compiles GPU shaders, which takes 10–20 seconds

offline.idle_release_desc: Frees the memory a model uses after a while without use and reloads it next time; the model files stay
offline.use_gpu_desc: Turn off if you see errors or empty results to run on the CPU instead
offline.use_gpu_desc_apple: Uses Metal; turn off if you see errors to run on the CPU instead
offline.release_idle: No model is loaded into memory

source_desc.auto: Picks the faster source and switches if one fails
source_desc.model_scope: ModelScope only, usually faster in mainland China

offline.source_note: Runtimes always come from the official GitHub releases
offline.runtimes_desc: Downloaded together with the models that need them
offline.runtime_in_use: A downloaded model uses it, so it can’t be deleted on its own
offline.licenses: PP-OCRv6, PaddleOCR-VL and Index-Translate are released under the Apache 2.0 license; llama.cpp and ONNX Runtime under the MIT License.
offline.load_failed_detail: Try again. If it keeps happening, export diagnostics from About
offline.runtime_downloading: A model being downloaded needs it

engine.confirm: Download {model} ({size})? Wisp switches to it once the download finishes
engine.confirm_unfit: {reason}. Download {model} ({size}) anyway? Wisp switches to it once the download finishes
engine.switch_later: Wisp switches to {model} once it’s downloaded
engine.local_only: Offline model, applies to this device only
engine.local_not_ready: Offline model, applies to this device only; until it finishes downloading, you’ll see the progress instead
engine.none_translate: Choose an offline model, or add a service above first
engine.ocr_desc: Offline models, text recognition services and models that accept images
